fieldValues.title: Reliability and Renewal
fieldValues.content: The standard defaults to **Reliability**: standing contracts continue to hold. Renewal is legitimate only as explicit supersession at a declared boundary, expressed through the retirement mechanism of the layer concerned; it must not arrive as an overwrite, an expired exception, or silent drift. This is axis 5–11, ruled in `rfc-decision-cce3c00e` and `rfc-decision-5f8204bc`.
